original_failure.detail: Root dedicated Bazel receipt fixture failed after167s at unchanged20s operation observation wait. Recipient attempt16 was Quiescent with result and sequence7; authority attempt16 remained authorized Uploading; old active hole was Running and negotiated session4 remained current. Coordinator Raft writes continued throughout the final20s. Previous successful Cargo qualification was insufficient to close this liveness failure.

diagnosis: The worker coalesced before tonic, but coordinator ingress materialized every received full inventory into its64-input FIFO. Repeated old reports, unchanged capacity and receipt delivery retries amplified serial durable writes. Slow journal work could put a completed candidate behind obsolete inventories. A new deterministic stopped-consumer test delivers256 successive inventory/capacity pairs and requires the final candidate, old active receipt and exact certificate in one notification. The original failed run did not record per-message ingress timestamps, so this is the verified backlog mechanism and corrective qualification rather than a claim to have reconstructed every original transport event.
changes: Each session retains latest complete reconciliation and capacity at ingress with one pending notification per segment; snapshot replacement, take, and queued flag share one mutex.

Taking clears the flag before awaits, so updates arriving during commit schedule another turn. Standalone Report rotates the mailbox, sealing earlier snapshots and preserving its ordering barrier against later capacity/inventory.

WorkerAccepted is proposed only for a Dispatching attempt. Duplicate same-phase progress and same-tick identical capacity skip durable no-op proposals; changed capacity and later-clock heartbeat still commit.
No candidate/core reducer or oracle implementation was inspected or changed. No20s fixture wait, process allowance, test count, or namespace requirement changed.
